text_block_list.text:
The day of Yaeno Muteki's debut race.
...I woke up early in the morning.
I go out for a walk to calm my nerves.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
choice_data_list: Practicing this early in the morning?
Practicing this early in the morning?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Today is my crucial debut race.
More thoroughly than usual,
I am in the midst of tempering the fierce fire within myself.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To lie low quietly until the right moment,
and unleash the flames at the decisive instant of battle.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I am reviewing our race tactics
while performing the form of the Eightfold Fence.

I thought she might be overly ferocious before the race,
but there seems to be no need to worry. For now,
Yaeno Muteki has her fighting spirit well under control.

Silently focusing her concentration,
Yaeno Muteki suddenly mutters.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
From here on begins the days of fierce, cutthroat battles...
...It gets my blood pumping.
choice_data_list: Are you... all right with that?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Please do not worry. The tactics and 'Unification of Fire and Water'
are firmly engraved in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
For this debut race, I shall pour in all my heart and soul
and display a run of "Fire and Water as One."

choice_data_list: I'm expecting great things from you!
